scope.purpose: Show a set of records in rows and columns so that values can be read and compared, as a native semantic data table.
useCases: A list of invoices, users or orders with a few columns, numbers aligned at the end.
Rich cells: a Badge for a status, a Link to the record, an Avatar with a name, a Menu of row actions.
A totals row in the footer.
A wide table that scrolls inline on a narrow screen; a table of limited height whose header stays visible.
exclusions: Sorting, row selection, expandable rows, column resizing or reordering, virtualization, inline editing: separately scoped enhancements (catalog), toward a later DataGrid.
Pagination inside the table: composed below with Pagination.
Loading state: composed with Skeleton rows.
Row hover and clickable rows in v1.
alternatives: DataField for the properties of a single record.
A list for items made of several lines of text.
DataGrid (later) for editing and large data sets.

fixtures: Badge, Link, Avatar, Menu and Pagination in the examples (content and composition, not dependencies).

examples.preview: dist/previews/table.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview table)

contract.scope: Table contract: required caption, hideCaption, size sm/md/lg (minimum row height size.control.{size}), columnLines (round 2); children header, body, footer, row, heading, cell (align, rowHeader); frame of border.width.default in color.border.subtle with radius.container, header band color.surface.subtle, every line color.border.subtle (round 2), headers typography.label.md secondary, cells typography.body.sm tabular; inline scroll area focusable while it overflows, sticky header; always framed (recommendation accepted).

decisionsTaken: Compound contract with children header, body, footer, row, heading (column header cell) and cell, so that cells hold free content (the semantic table of the catalog); no records API in v1 (row fields are not known in advance).
Headers in typography.label.md and color.content.secondary; cells in typography.body.sm with tabular figures; the typography does not change with size or density.
size sm, md, lg sets the minimum row height (size.control.{size}: 32, 40, 48 px in standard density); cells center one line and keep that block padding when they wrap.
Cell inline padding space.content.md (12 px in standard).
Visible caption by default (typography.heading.xs), hideCaption when a heading next to the table already names it; caption is required as the accessible name.

Inline overflow scrolls in the table's own area, which becomes a focus stop named by the caption only while it overflows; the header sticks to the top of that area when the integration limits its height.
A cell with rowHeader is exposed as the header of its row and looks like the other cells.

Round 2 style (user at the wave 5 contract gate, round 1 (2026-11-13), with three reference screenshots: "J'aime bien l'entête en gris léger avec des bordures en gris léger également"): header band in color.surface.subtle; every line in color.border.subtle (header, rows, footer); a frame of border.width.default in color.border.subtle with radius.container corners around the table (two of the three references are framed).
Optional columnLines (false by default): vertical lines between columns, as in two of the references.
Implementation: Svelte API: compound children as components (TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHeading, TableCell); align on cells and headings; rowHeader renders a th scope row.
Implementation: Contract amendments recorded in pendingChanges (paddingBlock, columns on one line).
implementationNotes: Exports Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHeading and TableCell.
The native caption is visually hidden and names the table; the visible caption above the frame is a copy hidden from assistive technology, so that it sits outside the frame.
The frame and the focus indicator are drawn by ::after on a frame wrapper, above the scroll area and the sticky header; the scroll area clips the table to the rounded corners.
Lines are inset box-shadows (rows keep minHeight whether they draw a line or not), replaced by borders in forced colors.
The scroll area becomes role region, named by the caption, with tabindex 0, only while it overflows (ResizeObserver on the area and the table).
The table is max-content wide with a minimum of 100%: columns keep their content on one line and the area scrolls.

pendingChanges.change: Contract facts found during implementation: (1) role paddingBlock (space.content.sm) on heading and cell; the block padding is reduced where needed so that one line fits in minHeight (sm), and content taller than one line grows the row and keeps that padding (with the padding that centers one line in minHeight, an Avatar or two lines in an md row would get 9.5 px above and below, and the sm row could not hold an sm Avatar). (2) Columns take the width of their content on one line and the table scrolls instead of squeezing them; text wraps where the integration limits a column's width (the first rendering wrapped identifiers such as SO-101 at their hyphen in a narrow column). To re-present at the wave 5 implementation gate.
